title: Bob Skills Marketplace vendor list (vendors.json)
description: The closed list of vendors allowed to publish packs. Only the owner of a product publishes packs about it. Changes require a PR with two marketplace-administrator approvals.

signature.description: Marketplace administrators' signature over the `vendors` array. null until admin keys exist; then the installer refuses an unsigned or tampered list.

id.description: Vendor id. Packs live under packs/<id>/ and reference it in pack.json `vendor`.

status.description: Only `active` vendors can release. `suspended` makes the installer and guard refuse every version from this vendor.

host.description: GitHub host of the vendor's organisation, e.g. github.com or github.ibm.com.

repos.description: Upstream repositories packs may be synced from.

maintainers.description: Logins on the registry's GitHub host allowed to change packs/<id>/. CI rejects PRs touching the folder from anyone else before scanners run. Must match CODEOWNERS.

publicKey.description: PEM-encoded cosign public key used to verify release signatures. null until the vendor enrols a key; the installer then falls back to sha256 checksums from the signed index.

networkAllow.description: Hosts (glob) the vendor's packs may reference in scripts. A pack's own networkAllow must be a subset.
